post.description: Dry run only: fake camera labels / gripper holding (§5.2).

idle → programming. 422 ``program_invalid`` (errors = the error/unconfirmed issues),
409 ``dry_run_required``. Dead-man heartbeat on.

get.description: The running (or last ended) run of this program; 404 when it never ran this launch.

post.description: Cancel the motion in flight (hold), then programming → stopping → idle.

After ``device_lost``: wait for the USB serial adapter to come back (same serial number,
by-id path or VID:PID, maybe under a new COM name), then connect again (calibration files
are written to the motors again).

idle → playing (session kind ``rest``): move the follower to its rest pose, minimum jerk at
a capped peak speed, dead-man heartbeat on; ``POST /sessions/current/control {"action": "stop"}``
cancels it. Offered after an interrupted motion (``Status.interrupted``).
External signal in (127.0.0.1 + token + ``X-Station: 1`` like every other call).

get.description: Trajectories of the active robot profile.

post.description: idle → recording_traj (countdown → capture). Same start checks as teleop (leader needed).
End the take; answers the new draft once the state is back to idle.

put.description: Rename, trim, save a draft. Refused (409 busy) while that trajectory is playing.

post.description: needs_check → ready, only after a completed ``check`` replay of the current calibration.
idle → playing (approach → replay). Dead-man heartbeat on.
